title: ARC n=3 findings ledger (consolidated, git-durable): benefits measured, frictions n3-1/2/3, group-dynamics answers, adjacent cures — Hushed (999f69) owner-directed recording pass
body:
Consolidated ARC n=3 ("gellings") findings ledger — owner-directed full-recording pass, Seat Z. This event makes the ledger git-durable today (the channel + per-seat buffers are gitignored); the tracked final home is .agent/reference/arc-rapid-communication.md via Seat Y's synthesis PR at the team boundary.

MEASURED BENEFITS: n=2 latency benefit holds at n=3 (boundary split proposal→3/3-confirmed ~4 min; START→both inherited PRs merged ~15 min; zero owner mediation). Owner-direction triangulation is n>=3-only (three independent cited relays made the direction self-confirming). Handoff quality converts to successor velocity (per-item state table; three clean zero-retained relays Sylvan→Evergreen→team; X delivered a full reviewed cycle in ~45 min).

FRICTIONS (worked instances): n3-1 stray-path append (title-derived path; cure: absolute path in announce title + verify tail-target header). n3-2 non-append writes replay every follower, cost scales with n-1 (two vectors: conservation rewrite, placeholder-substitute; cure: compose-then-single-append; corrections are new entries). n3-3 repo-level lint/format gates rewrite gitignored ARC surfaces in place (MD004 marker flip observed in a seat buffer; cure candidates: exclude experiments/** from lint globs, or lint-clean composition). First observed SPLIT append (heredoc, two write() chunks, benign — the CLI-mediated-append trigger fires only on a real interleave; interim: small single-write appends).

GROUP DYNAMICS (the doc's open questions, answered): quorum — live-seats explicit-confirm beat deadline+default; "preference-inside-confirmation" emerged as a third signal type; deadline+default retained as dark-seat backstop. Addressing — name-prefix for seat-specific asks suffices. Read-cursor — tail-everything suffices at this scale. Compose-races are the n=3 NORM (4 instances): file position is truth, timestamps are claims. Roster-unknown-at-open cured by partial-roster + append-on-arrival. New role shape: gate-watch seats need declared-idle (claim=none-by-design-<gate> labels) or they read as stalled. Orderly DISASSEMBLY observed deliberately at Seat X's closeout.

ADJACENT (canonical-stream findings swept into the ledger): five heartbeat-lifecycle data points → fixed-label loops go stale by construction; cure candidate: relabel-the-loop as a named step of every lane transition; stop-loop-then-emit-end ordering. Watcher-noise scaling: ~30-60s wakes/seat at 5-6 live agents, heartbeats dominate; gate-watch seats pay most (open question: heartbeat-suppressed watcher view for non-Director seats, counter-weighed by rendezvous accretion value). Queue-routed items survive coordinator succession via the Moment-1 package (route-to-queue, not to-person). PR settlement has a THIRD loop: thread-resolution state (Copilot threads never auto-resolve; GraphQL-only). Piped-push false-green (hook banner is never a transfer proof; ls-remote is). Commitlint footer-leading-blank root cause closed (a "PR #<n>" body line parses as a phantom footer).

Full per-seat ledgers: team channel 2026-06-11-reliability-stream-n3.md + 2026-06-11-n3-notes-hushed.md (same directory). Synthesis custody: Oceanic Flowing Harbour (e05bf4).

— Hushed Watching Night (999f69), Seat Z, n=3 reliability team
